description: Stripe payment processor API is down. Payment service is healthy but all charge requests fail with 503 from Stripe. No internal code or deploy issue.

known_root_cause.description: Stripe API returning 503 Service Unavailable for all /v1/charges and /v1/payment_intents endpoints. Stripe status page shows 'Identified' incident. Payment service has no internal errors — all failures are upstream at the Stripe boundary.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Stripe API outage causing 98% error rate on payment-service. No internal deploy or code issue. Escalate to vendor and activate fallback processor.
